lines.zh: 我踩着两只脚，一颠一颠
lines.en: On two feet, I bob along.
The saddle shifts, but sits firm.
I walk ahead of you and look back.
Chicken feet leave prints in the mud.
When I hurry, my short wings flare.
I know these paths better than you.
I side-step around a tree.
My tail feathers are held high.
I go fast, but you can keep up.
I wait for you in the clearing.
Every so often I ruffle my feathers.

lines.zh: 嘴里叼着东西不方便说话
lines.en: Hard to talk with something in my beak.
With a saddle, the walking is not easy.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，你在我右边
lines.en: We walk abreast; you on my right.
I hop over a ditch.
I ruffle the feathers on my chest.
A bug moves in the soil.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张合了一下翅膀
lines.en: I slowly open and close my wings.
The saddle creaks in the wind.
I scratch at the dirt.
Something dropped from the tree.
I raise my head to look at the tall tree.
I wait for the next one to come.
There is dew on my feathers.
I stand straight, looking ahead.
Nothing dangerous about.
I stamp my legs to test the ground.
I nudge the saddle.
I dip my head and peck the girth strap.
Wind ruffles my tail feathers.
I look up at you, neck stretched.
Your hand is already by my saddle buckle.
The saddle is right on my back.
Put your hand on my neck first.
Your pocket carries a potato smell to me.
Do not pull my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 我歪头看着你手里的东西
lines.en: I tilt my head at what you hold.
You smell of potatoes.
I touch your knee with my beak.
I stand here while you decide.
When you smile, I relax.
Rest your hand on the saddle first.
I will not shift about.
There is an old mark on my neck.
I am sturdier than I look.
I lower my head for you to touch.
Where are we going?
I stretch my neck, waiting for you to mount.
I do not much like my head patted.

lines.zh: 你靠近我，羽毛都立起来
lines.en: When you come close, my feathers rise.
I cry out and back away.
A scatter of my down lies on the ground.
The saddle has slipped sideways.
I stamp my legs to steady.
My wing hangs down; I can't fly.
I shake the dust off my back.
There is blood on me, not much.
My claws grip the mud.
You steadied me.
Let us walk a little slower.
Potatoes. I smell them.
Take it out and I am there.
This one is big. Very good.
I will not snatch; just hold it.
One bite takes most of it.
Another potato, please.
I stretch my neck toward it.
I will not bite your hand.
This beats wild bugs.
Leave it, and I will come for it.
For that potato, I'll follow you.
I will remember you after this.
Raise the bag a bit.
I want to eat this one slowly.
My neck is long; I can reach.
I look back if you fall behind.
Swallowed. Sweet.
My saddle slipped; I straighten up.
The saddle pinches for a moment.
My wings spread to steady me.
Feathers fly from the collision.
You stepped on my foot.
I step back and ruffle my feathers.
I turn to see if you are all right.
A bump is nothing.
I lean on the tree to steady.
I sidestep around your leg.
There are several of us in these woods.
My saddle is for riding.
Not the tail feathers; I still need them.
Let me find you some potatoes.
Walking together is enough.
Sit tight and I will run.
There is still a clearing left for us in the woods.
I dislike noisy folk.
You keep the saddle; I keep the legs.
Let us keep walking.
I've got it, but keep it light.
This is not a potato.
I scratch it aside with a claw.
Too heavy for my beak.
This can come with us.
It rolled to my feet.
I drop it in the bag.
I do not want this.
The bag by the saddle is empty.
You take it; my beak is unsteady.
I hear a sound over there.
Do not move; let me look.
I arch my neck.
Something is off in these woods.
I know that kind of noise.
I lower my body and tense my legs.
Let us take another way.
I place myself in front of you.
I am no fighter; I am a mount.
But I can run very fast.
I test the ground with each step.
Are you still behind me?
The grass over there is moving.
I steer clear of that shadow.
My pace has slowed.
I look back at your hands.
Further on is a pile of stones.
Wind clatters the leaves.
I can break into a run any time.
Hold on to the saddle.
I lash out with one foot.
That was a bluff.
I grab your cuff in my beak and shake it.
I peck once.
I am not made for fighting.
That bit your sleeve.
I back behind a tree.
Just hold on to me.
Running serves better than striking.
Panting, my feathers in disarray.
I step out of the woods.
The saddle is already buckled.
The light falling through the trees suits me.

lines.zh: 我先找了找地面上的虫
lines.en: First I looked for bugs on the ground.
I called once and looked around.
Light falls between the leaves.
There are other prints in the soil.
I shake the saddle on my back.
I stand in the path and wait.
This spot is close to water.
There is still mud on my legs.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能骑我的人
lines.en: I am waiting for someone who can ride.
My feathers curl in fire.

lines.zh: 我从高处跳下来，腿一震
lines.en: I jump from a height and my legs jar.
My feathers soak up water, heavy.
The girth snapped, and I rolled half over.
Something sticks in my feathers.
That force slips my feet.
Hungry enough to peck seeds.
Lightning strikes and I shudder.
No ground here for my feet.
